Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle

Class DynamicLoader

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle.DynamicLoader
public class DynamicLoader extends Object
Polls a ModelRegistry on a per-model schedule and automatically deploys newly discovered versions through a LifecycleManager — this is the "dynamic loading" milestone: instead of an operator calling deploy() by hand every time a new model version is published, DynamicLoader notices it and rolls it out on its own, going through the same validate → warm → atomic swap → retire path as a manual deployment.

Each watched model id gets its own scheduled poll; polls for a given model never overlap (if a deploy triggered by one poll is still running when the next poll fires, that poll is skipped rather than queued).

Usage:


 DynamicLoader loader = new DynamicLoader(lifecycleManager, modelRegistry);
 loader.watch("fraud-detector", Duration.ofSeconds(30));
 // ... new versions registered in modelRegistry are now picked up automatically ...
 loader.unwatch("fraud-detector");
 loader.shutdown();
Since:
0.1.0

  • Method Details

    • watch

      public void watch(String modelId, Duration pollInterval)
      Starts polling the registry for a model id on a fixed delay. Replaces any existing watch for the same model id.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the logical model id to watch (resolved against the registry as ModelReference.of(String), i.e. "whatever is latest")
      pollInterval - delay between the end of one poll and the start of the next

    • unwatch

      public void unwatch(String modelId)
      Stops polling for a model id. No-op if it wasn't being watched.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to stop watching

      public void shutdown()
